tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'khor lo bde mchog gi sngags phreng bzhugs// oṃ na mo bha ga bcom ldan 'das/ wa te wi ri shwa ya/ dpa' bo'i dbyangs phyug ma hā kalpagni bskal pa chen po'i me 'dra ba/ sam̐ ni bhā ya/ dza ṭa ma ku ṭoṭka ṭa ya/ ral pa'i cod pan mi zad pa/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa skrag pa 'jigs pa'i zhal can/ dam̐ṣṭa ka lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu khā ya/ sa ha pra/ stong / bhu dza bha su ra ya/ phyag pa ra shu dgra satwa zhags pa thogs pa/ pra sha dya ta shu la kha rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ sa paṇa gyi mchan las/ ṭwam̐ ga dha ra ṇa/ byā ghra dzī nāmba ra dha ra ya/ stag gi pags pa'i na bza' 'dzin pa/ mahā dhum brandha ka ra wa pu ṣā ya/ dud pa chen po dang mun pa 'dra ba'i sku/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i le'u gnyis pa na yod cing a bhi dha na'i le'u nga bdun pa na yod gsungs so/ /'di yan gyi rkang brgyad la yi ge brgyad cu rtsa gnyis yod pas 'di mu tig phreng ba'i lugs ltar rgyud rang nas btus/ 'di man gyi dpa' bo nyer bzhi'i sngags 'di yang de dang 'brel chags su bris pa yin gyi/ btu ba dngos/ ka ra ka ra/ byos shig byos shig ku ru ku ru/ gyis shig gam mdzod gnyis/ bandha bandha/ chings gnyis/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ skrag par gyis gnyis/ kṣo bha ya dkrugs shig gnyis/ kṣo bha ya/ hroṃ hroṃ/ phung khams skye mched byang sems nyi ma byang sems nor bur gnas pa'i tshe lhan skyes rtog pa/ stong pa /hra hra/ bde ba des tshim pa/ pheṃ pheṃ/ 'dzin med/ phaṭ phaṭ/ bdag med/ da ha da ha/ bsreg gnyis/ pa tsa pa tsa/ tshos gnyis/ bhakṣa bhakṣa/ bza' ba gnyis/ ba su ru ti/ zhag khrag a ra na tra ma lā/ rgyu ma'i phreng ba/ ba liṃ bi ṇa/ 'phyang ba/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ zungs gnyis/ sapta bdun/ pā tā la sa 'og ga ta son pa/

bu dzaṃ lag 'gro gam̐ sarbam̐ sbrul/ bā tardza ya sdigs gnyis/ tardza ya/ a kaṭadhya a kaṭadhya/ mid gnyis/ a ka sde chen gsum pa dang / /bzhi pa rlung la yang dag gnas/ /zhes pa ṭa dang dhya brtsegs nas ya tas brgyan pa'o/ /hriṃ hriṃ/ dzaṇauṃ dzaṇauṃ/ a bhi dha na'i le'u nga bdun par/ gnyis pa yi yang gsum pa ni/ /gsum pa'i lnga pa la gnas pa/ /zhes gsungs pas ṇa yin no/ /dpe phal la nya rang du bris 'dug kṣ+mam̐ kṣ+mam̐/ hām̐ hām̐/ slar yang ri khrod ces bya ba gnyis pa'i mda' dang yang dag ldan zhes gsungs pa'i ring po'o/ /hiṃ hiṃ/ slar yang gnyis pa'i mda' yi ni/ ri khrod yongs su brgyan pa'o/ /zhes dbyangs gsum is ha brgyan pas heng thung ngu yin no/ /hūm̐ hūm̐/ ki li ki li/si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li/ hūm̐ hūm̐ slar yang ri khrod ces bya ba'i/ /lnga pa'i mda' ni gdan du bya/ /zhes bshad pas u thung ngu bshad pa'i phyir hūm̐ gnyis kyang thung ngu yin no zhes bshad do/ /hi li'i dod la'ang tsi li yod do/ /yang 'grel par phaṭ gnyis dang swāhā sbyar gyis/ hūm̐ gnyis mi snang la/ rgyud rang du hūm̐ gnyis phaṭ gcig byas 'dug go /phaṭ/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i lugs dzñauṃ bu ba gzhung dang 'grel ba gnyis ka na mi snang / 'grel pa'i lugs la mgor oṃ/ mjug tu swāhā sbyor te/ thog mar oṃ ste swāhā'i mthar/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /yab kyi rtsa sngags so/ /oṃ na mgo 'dren phyag 'tshal lo/ /mo bha ga bcom ldan 'das ma/ wa ti/ badzra wā rā hi bam̐/ rdo rje phag mo/ ārya 'phags ma/ a pa ra dzi te gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ trai lokya 'jig rten gsum gyi/ mā te yum/ mahā chen mo/ bi dya rig pa'i/ shwa ri dbyangs phyug ma/ sarba bhu 'byung po/ ta bha ya 'jigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ bha he mahā 'jigs shing 'jigs pa sel ba'i/

badzre/ rdo rje chen mo/ badzra rdo rje'i gdan ma/ ā sa ne ā mi thub cing / te a pa mi pham ma/ ra dzi te/ wa shya dbang du byed pa'i/ ka byed pa'i/ ri/ ne tra/ spyan/ bhra bsgyur ma/ ma ne/ 'phrul ma/ sho ṣa skem ma/ ni/ ro ṣa 'jigs su rung ma/ ni/ drag mo/ kro dha/ khro mo khros pa/ ka ra li ni/ mdzad ma/ tra sa ni/ skrag par/ ma ra ṇa/ bsad par/ pra bhe rab du 'byed ma/ da ni/ a pa gzhan las rgyal/ ra dza ye/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ bi dza ye/ rnam par rgyal ma/ dzambha ni/ rmugs byed ma/ stambha ni/ rengs par byed ma/ mo ha ni/ rmongs byed ma/ badzra wa ra hi/ rdo rje phag mo/ mahā chen po/ yo gi rnal 'byor ma/ ni/ ka 'dod pa'i/ me dbang phyug shwa ri/ kha mkha' 'gro ma/ ge tadya yum gyi phreng sngags 'di lta ste/ thā/ pro tam̐ mchog gi ge pro tam̐ mchog ge ha na ha na/ snun nam rgyobs gnyis/ pra ṇan/ srog la/ kiṃ dgos pa/ ki srog chags la'ang zer/ ni/ khi dbyer kha/ 'phyang ba/ khi ṇi/ sim sim ma/ dhu bskyod/ na dhu 'dar ba'am dbye ba/ na/ badzra rdo rje legs pas/ haste/ sho ṣa skoms shig ya/ sho ṣa skoms shig ya/ badzra rdo rje/ kha mkhal dbyug dang / ṭam̐ ga ka pā la/ thod pa'i/ mā lā/ phreng ba/ dhā ri ṇi/ 'dzin ma/ ma hā chen mo/ pi sha pi ta/ sha'i rnam grangs/ mām̐ sā sha ni/ sha rnams gsol ba/ ma nu mi'i/ ṣānt+ra/ rgyu ma/ pra se ral kha bri te/ rgyan cing 'bar zer/ sam̐ ni dhyaṃ/ yid kyi 'dod pa la 'jug cing g.yo ba med/ na rā sī/ ra mā mi'i mgo bo/ lā/ phreng ba'i rgyud/ gram̐ ṭhi ta/ dhā ri ṇi/ 'dzin ma/

sumbha/ gnod mdzes/ ni sumbhe/ nges par gnod mdzes/ ha na ha na/ snun cig snun cig pra ṇam̐/ srog la/ sarba pa shu pa nām̐/ phyugs thams cad nyed pa/ ma hā chen mo/ mām̐ sa/ sha tstshe da ni/ gcod pa/ kro dha khro bo/ murte/ lus/ dam̐ṣṭa ka ra li ni/ mche ba gtsigs pa mo/ ma hā mu tre/ phyag rgya chen mo/ shrī he ru ka de wa sya/ dpal khrag 'thung lha mo/ a gra/ mchog gi ma hi shi btsun mo/ sa ha sra shi re/ stong phrag gi dbu/ sa ha sra bā ha be/ stong phrag gi phyag can/ sha ta sa ha sra/ brgya phrag stong gi anne/ 'od zer/ dzwa li ta/ 'bar ba'i/ te dza sya/ gzi brjid can/ dzwa la mu khi/ 'bar ba'i gdong can/ siṃ ga la lo tsa ni/ dmar ser gyi spyan can/ badzra sha rī re/ rdo rje'i sku can/ badzra ā sa ne/ rdo rje gdan can ma/ mi li te/ de ltar 'joms ma/ he he/ thung thung / hūm̐ hūm̐/ ring ring / kha kha/ thung thung / dhu dhu/ dhu ru dhu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ muñtsa muñtsa/ a dwi te/ gnyis su med pa'i/ ma hā yo gi ni/ rnal 'byor ma chen mo/ sa thi ta/ bklags pas grub ma/ siddhe/ draiṃ dham̐/ draiṃ dham̐/ gram̐ gram̐/ thung thung / he he/ ha ha/ thung thung / bhi me/ 'jigs ma/ ha sa/ khos/ ha sa/ khos/ bī re/ dpal mo/ hā hā/ ring ring / ho ho/ ring ring / hūm̐ hūm̐/ ring ring / trai lokya bi 'jig rten gsum rnam par 'joms ma/ na sha ni/ sha rnam par 'jigs byed ma brgya/ ta sa ha stong / sra ko ṭi/ bye ma ma/ ta thā ga ta/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i/ pa ri wa re/ 'khor gyis bskor la/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ/ siṃ ha ru pe kha/ seng ge'i gzugs can/ ga dza ru pe kha/ glang po'i gzugs can/

trai lokya u da re/ 'jig rten gsum gyi lto ba can ma/ sa mu tra rgya mtsho/ me kha la/ ska rags can ma/ gra sa gra sa/ zo zo/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ kye dpa' mo wī ra dāai te hūm̐ hūm̐/ ring ring / ha ha/ ring ring / ma hā pā shu/ phyugs chen mo/ mo hā ni/ rmongs par byed ma/ ma hā yo gi shwa ra twam̐/ rnal 'byor chen po'i dbang phyug ma khyod/ ḍā ki ni/ mkha' 'gro ma/ sarba lo ka nāṃ/ 'jig rten thams cad rnams/ bandha ni/ 'ching ba ma/ sadyaḥ skad cig myur du/ pra tya ya/ bsgrub par/ kā ri ni/ byed ma/ yid ches pa'i the tshom med par/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bhu ta tra sa ni/ 'byung po thams cad skrag par mdzad ma/ ma hā wi ri/ dpa' mo chen mo/ pa ra ma siddhe/ yo gi shwa ri phaṭ/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ma/ hūm̐ hūm̐ thung ngu gnyis/ phaṭ/ gcig hūm̐ ring ba gnyis/ hūm̐ phaṭ gcig yum gyi rtsa sngags so/ /sngags phreng 'di ni lū nag gi lugs/ bla dpe las 'byung ba bzhir bzhag cing / yig 'bru'i ring thung la sogs pa mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'grel pa gru gzings las 'byung ba bzhin dag par byas la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams yi ge rnying pa dbang btsan pa byas nas bris pa yin no/ /mi 'dra ba'i khyad par che ba rnams ni bla ma gong ma'i mchan bu las gsal bar 'byung bas shes la/ mjug gi hūm̐ phaṭ kyi grangs nges ni/ he ru ka mngon 'byung las ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā zhes hūm̐ lnga dang phaṭ gnyis swāhā dang bcas pa 'byung la/ zer yang hūm̐ gnyis bris pa yang snang ngo / /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las ni hūm̐ gnyis/ phaṭ gcig swāhā dang bcas pa 'byung ngo / /yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las/ phaṭ phaṭ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes hūm̐ bzhi dang phaṭ bzhir yang bshad la/

a bhi dha na las hūm̐ gnyis phaṭ gcig swāhā dang bcas pa bshad la/ zer yang hūm̐ med par bris pa yang 'dug go /yang phag mo mngon 'byung gi rgyud las rgyud rang na hūm̐ gnyis phaṭ gcig swāhā dang bcas pa snang ngo / /hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā zhes ring po bzhi phaṭ gnyis swāhā dang bcas pa yang yod pa ni/ mtha' gcig tu ni ma nges so/ /'on kyang yum gyi rtsa ba'i sngags kyi btu ba ni mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho kho na la gsal bar bzhugs pas/ de'i lugs la mig 'bru'i grangs nges sogs zhib par yod kyang / lugs gzhan la bsre mi btub pas/ bla dpe rnying pa dang / yang dag pa'i bla ma'i gsung rgyun gtso bor bya'o/ /hūm̐ snga ma gnyis thung ngu dang phyi ma gnyis ring por byas pa ni/ bde mchog stod 'grel las gsungs pas de'i lugs su bris pa yin par sems so/ /'on kyang lū nag gi skabs su de ltar nges pa med ces gsungs pas/ hūm̐ bzhi ka ring por bris kyang chog gam yang sems so/ /gang ltar yang lugs gcig kho nas gzhan rnams bcos su mi rung bas/ rgyud tha dad pa'i sngags so sor byed pa gal che'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang sngags dag par bya ba'i phyir btsun pa bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyis yun ring du nan tan byas pa las 'byung pa'o/ /slob dpon u ma pa ti'i phag mo'i sgrub thabs las/ 'dir bla ma'i gdams ngag rab gtum ma la sogs pa'i sngags 'di rnams kyi hūm̐ dang po rnams thung ngu / gnyis pa rnams ring por 'dod pa'o/ /zhes dmigs bsal lta bu yang gsungs snang ngo / /sgrub thabs der/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā zhes hūm̐ ring po bzhi bris 'dug go /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang / phag mo mngon 'byung sogs phal che ba nas hūm̐ gnyis phaṭ gcig swāhā dang bcas pa bshad pas/ 'dir yang de bzhin du rung ngam yang sems so/ /oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ ḍā ki nī dzā la samba ram̐ swāhā/

yab kyi snying po'o/ /oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ yum gyi snying po'o/ /oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yab kyi nye snying ngo / /oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ yum gyi nye snying ngo / /oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā ma ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛhṇa pa ya gṛhṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇḍā ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan badzra rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rū pi ṇi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags dang snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i ming spel ba'o/ /oṃ ka ra ka ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pra tsaṇḍe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ku ru ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tsaṇḍa akṣi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bandha bandha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pra bhā wa tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tra sa ya tra sa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma ha na se hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kṣo bha ya kṣo bha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bī ra ma ti ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hrauṃ hrauṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kharpa rī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hraḥhraḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ liṅka shwa ri ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pheṃ pheṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dru ma tstsha ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ phaṭ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ai ka rā wa ti ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ da ha da ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā bhe ra bī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ wa yu be ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bhakṣa bhakṣa ba sa ru dhi ri ant+ra mā lā ba lambi ne hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ su rā bhakṣi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa sapta pā ta la ga ta bhu dzaṅgu sarbamba tardza ya tardza ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shya mā de wi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ a kaṭadhya a kaṭadhya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ su bha dre hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ ha ya karṇe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dzñāauṃ dzñāauṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kha gā na ne hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kṣ+maṃ kṣ+maṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tsakra be ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hāṃ hāṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hīṃ hīṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shauṇḍi ne ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tsakra warmi ṇi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ki li ki li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ su bī re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ si li si li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā ba la hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hi li hi li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tsakra warti nī ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dhi li dhi li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā bīrye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i sngags so/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te wi re sha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kā kā sye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā kalpa agni sannī bhā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ a lū ka sye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dza ṭa ma ku ṭatko ṭā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shwa n+ya sye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dam̐ṣṭa ka rā lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu khā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ su ka ra sye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sa ha pra bhu dza bha su rā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma dā ḍadhi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pā ra shu pa shodya ta shu la kha ṭwam̐ ga dha ri ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma dhu tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ byā gra dzi na amba ra dha rā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma dam̐ṣṭi ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mahā dhumadra andha kā ra wa pu ṣa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma ma tha ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yab kyi rkang brgyad pa dang / sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi ming spel ba'i sngags so/ /de ltar ji ltar 'dod pa bzla bar bya'o/ /'khor lo bde mchog gi yan lag gi sngags mchan dang bcas pa bzhugs/ oṃ hrīḥ 'di he ru ka mngon 'byung gi 'grel par gzhon nu zla bas/ ma mo gnyis dag ni ma mo gnyis pa ste de'i yang gnyis pa'i ma mo ni yi ge i ste bzhi pa zhes bya ba'i don to zhes ring por byas/

tsheg drag sdom 'byung las kyang gsungs/ logs su thig le gnyis sbyin par bya/ zhes so/ /ha ha ha gnyis su po he ru ka mngon 'byung las/ sum cu gsum pa zhes dang / sdom 'byung las kyang thung ngur bshad do/ /de'i rgyu mtshan/ re mig dag ni bdun pa yis/ /yi ge bzhi pa bzung byas te/ /lan gnyis ha ha ni bzlas par bya/ /slar yang yi ge de nyid bzung / /dbyangs a yig lnga pas 'og tu brgyan/ /zhes gsungs pas/ hūm̐ ring po yin na dbyangs lnga pa u thung gis brgyan pa mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /'di'i snga ma ha gnyis kyang thung ngur grub bo/ /rgyu mtshan ni u thung gis rgyan rgyu yin pa de la ha ring mi srid pas so/ /hūm̐ dbyangs lnga pa yis 'og tu brgyan pa thung ngu'o/ /hūm̐ phaṭ/ gsod pa zhes he ru ka mngon 'byung gi 'grel par bshad do// ༈ //dpa' bo nyer bzhi'i sngags mchan dang bcas pa bzhugs/ oṃ ka zer/ ra las bsags pa las kyi phyag rgya la sogs pa rdzogs par byas la de dang lhan cig snyoms par 'jug pa'i las la gnas nas sngon gyi las mthar byed pa byos shig pa'o/ /las bsags pa mthar byed pa byos shig bzung la sogs pa'i sems dpa' ste blo dang las ngan pa'i rtsa ba chags pa dang bral bar byos shig pa'o/ /bral bar gyis shig ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ bandha bandha bcing pa ste gang 'ching na ral pa gya gyur gsal ba bcing ba'o/ /yang na ral pa ni bod pa/ gya gyu ni gya gyu can sdang ba rnams chings shig pa'o/ /yang na ral pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi tshogs/ don la rang bzhin med kyang / kun rdzob sna tshogs su snang bas gya gyu/ bcing pa ni don der bdag med pa'i 'khor los de dag btus te ston pa po nyid bstan pa'o/ /'di la'ang 'bru non mi 'dug yang na sdang ba'i phung po la sogs pa dkrugs par ston/ tra sa ya nor bzang 'grel par ya med/ skrag par gyis ji ltar na gzugs dang bral ba de sdang ba dang bral ba'i bar du'o/

/tra sa ya/ kṣo bha ya/ brdar rdo lta bu'i kun rdzob bden pa don dam bden au cha gnyis pas thabs shes rab mtshon pas brdar ba ste spyad pas na ka sha ste brdar ba'o/ /kṣo bha ya/ hroṃ hroṃ/ thabs shes rab/ hraḥ nyi ma/ chos 'byung / hraḥ stong pa'i ri mo/ phaiṃ 'dzin med/ phai ཾ/ des na bzung med/ phaṭ yang na phaṭ ni bdag med pa bskyed pa ni grub mtha' de nyid gnas pa'o/ /phaṭ/ bsgyings te sgrags pa'o/ /da ha da ha/ yang na snun gnyis/ 'di la'ang 'bru non mi 'dug ste sgra'i bstan bcos las da ha thal bar byed pa la'o/ /yang na bsregs/ pa tsa 'di la'ang 'bru mi 'dug pa tsa/ tshod yang na tshos/ bhakṣa/ bhakṣa/ sems kyi rnam par rtog pa'i bdud za ba'o/ /ba sa khrag dang zhag ru dhi 'di la'ang 'bru non mi 'dug go /ra/ ant+ra mā mā rgyu ma'i phreng ba/ ba 'phyang ba/ lambi ne 'di la'ang mi 'dug gṛhṇa 'di la'ang mi 'dug gṛhṇa/ zungs gnyis/ sapta pā tā la/ sa 'og rim pa bdun gyi sbrul lam lto ba phye ste rnam par rtog pa 'di dag tshar bcad cing bzung ba'o/ /ga ta gnas pa'ang zer/ bhu dzaṃ ga 'di la'ang mi 'dug sarba bā lag 'gro sbrul la/ tardza ya/ yang na rtogs gnyis/ tardza ya/ sdigs gnyis 'di la'ang mi 'dug ā kaṭadhya/ ā kaṭadhya/ rnam pa'i rang bzhin ro gcig par med pa'o/ /hrīṃ hrīṃ/ has rigs bzhi char gyi bdag nyid he ru ka mtshon/ lan gnyis bzlas pas shes rab kyi cha dang sbyar ba mtshon/ kṣ+mam̐ kṣ+mam̐/ ṣa dang ka sde ba ma spros/ rig pa'i ye shes de gzung 'dzin zad pa'i spros pa med pa'i mthar gtugs pa'o/ /ham̐ ham̐/ mda' gnyis pa/ hiṃ hiṃ/ mda' gsum pa/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ mda' lnga pa/ ki li ki li/ bde ba la spyod pa'o/ /si li yang na 'khor lo bzhi/

si li/ pam̐ tsu ni zlum pa ste gnyis su med pa'o/ /tsi tsi tsi li/ dhi li rnam par dag pa'i blos/ dhi li/ sdom pas gnyis su med pa'i bde ba la spyod pa na shin tu rnam par dag pa'i blo gros sgra'i tshe na 'don pa zhes pa'o/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ gnyis pa ring thung gi gsal rgyu bha ba'i 'grel pa na med nor bzang dka' 'grel du thung ngur bshad do/ /hūm̐/ u sgras thabs zla tshes thig les shes rab kyi cha'o/ /phaṭ/ sgra ji bzhin pa/ swāhā/ thog mar oṃ ste swāhā'i mthar zhes gsungs pas swa bhā wa gsungs/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa yi ge bcu gsum pa yin/ nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki yi ge nyi shu pa yin/ 'di ltar man snyer bshad/ nā ye/ badzra warṇa ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha 'di la rtsa rgyud kyi le'u sum cu pa'i gnod mdzes kyi sngags mu tig phreng ba ltar btus pa yin/ a bh-i las kyang badzra rkyang pa min pa thu ba mi snang ngo / /hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛhṇa pa ya gṛhṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ a na ya ho bha ga bāṃ badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha gzhan rnams kyi dag byed zhal gnyis pa'i gzhung gsum po phal cher/ tsha steng yig ces gsungs pas/ ba rkyang pa btus so/ /sha log ste ma sha steng gzhon zhes bshad pas/ da dha brtsegs pa'o/ /ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa ra steng ra'i steng mas sbyar zhes ind+ra bo dhi'o/ /nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa na ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ pa'i dbus na yi ge lnga dang / ri ring 'og mas khyer bar bya/ /zhes hūm̐ gsum ring por bshad do/ /mthun zhing / 'on kyang de kho na nyid kyi ye shes bsgrub pa'i 'grel par/ slob dpon brtson 'grus dpal bshes gnyen gyi/ wa 'og gnas pa ḍa 'og stong ba can zhes pas/

ḍa'i 'og na gnas pa u yig la stong pa zhes pa thig le ste zla tshes dang bcas pa gdam ngag go /de gnyis dang ldan pas gsum po ni/ wa'i 'og na gnyis pa'i ha la sbyin pas ha yig ni gsum du bya'o/ /u thung ba gsum thig le dang bcas pa ha yig la sbyin pas gsum mo/ /a wa dha ti pas hūm̐ ring por byas pa ni sgrub thabs gzhan yin la skyon med do zhes bshad do/ /sngags btu gzhan rnams kyang / 'di dang gzhan cung zad mi 'dra bar bshad 'dug go /sngags 'di rnams int+ra bhu ti chen pos mdzad pa'i zhal gnyis ma chung ba'i gzhung nas btus pa yin la/ gzhung 'di ni phag mo thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa yin no zhes rje btsun chen pos gsungs so/ /phag mo zhal gnyis ma la dpe ris ltar bri/ mchod pa khor mar bsham/ de skabs su rigs lnga'i sdom bzung mi mdzad/ slob ma lag pa sbrel ba'i dmigs pa tsam mdzad/ me tog dor ba sogs kyi gsal kha med na'ang phyag len la mdzad do/ /yang me tog mig dar sogs bris pa'i skabs su oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod/ oṃ gsum ma 'di la yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis yod ces bshad de/ yi ge'i srog bgrangs pa'i dbang du byas pa yin no// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 a myes zhabs/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi sngags phreng / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 7
